snippet.title: Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era — Schism Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Something ancient and forbidden is coming to Jadame! Join us as we reveal the secret 6th faction and unleash otherworldly powers in Olden Era! Built around unavoidable damage and ability control, Schism is finally here to unveil its mysteries!

Wishlist Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3105440/Heroes_of_Might__Magic_Olden_Era/

Music credits: Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era — Schism Town Theme
